title: Contradiction Report
description: DISCOVER-stage typed artifact. Output of contradiction-miner. Records pairs of claims that make opposing or numerically incompatible statements about the same phenomenon. Each conflict entry requires two claim_refs and a conflict kind.

n_claims_checked.description: total number of claims examined in this mining pass

claim_ref_a.description: claim_id of the first conflicting claim

claim_ref_b.description: claim_id of the second conflicting claim

description.description: brief prose explaining why these claims conflict

synthesis_attempt.description: Optional (2026-08-07). What would have to be true for BOTH sides to hold at once. 'No synthesis found' is a legitimate and useful answer; a synthesis that merely averages the two numbers is not one. A conflict with a real synthesis attempt is a candidate research direction, not just a data-quality note — which is why the ideation seats read this field.

opposition_is_formalization_artifact.description: Optional (2026-08-07). true / false / 'unknown': whether the opposition is an artifact of how the two papers formalized the problem rather than a fact about the world. 'unknown' is the honest default.
